// Command genv1 writes the format 1 index used by the csearch tests.
package main

import (
	"os"
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/codesearch/index"
)

func main() {
	iw := index.Create(os.Args[1])
	iw.AddPaths([]string{"/fixture"})
	// names must be added in sorted order
	iw.Add("/fixture/cmd/main.go", strings.NewReader("package main\n\nfunc main() { needle() }\n"))
	iw.Add("/fixture/lib/haystack.go", strings.NewReader("package lib\n\n// nothing to find here\n"))
	iw.Add("/fixture/lib/needle.go", strings.NewReader("package lib\n\nfunc needle() {}\n"))
	iw.Flush()
}
